scan_config.seeds: one seed per labelled endpoint (the 'seed' of each ground-truth entry, with its baseline values); the app is a single-page app
scan_config.excluded_not_probed: the login endpoints /api/v2/login and /api/v1/login (rate-limited to 100 attempts per 30 s; probing them is a brute-force pattern) and every parameter-less route
scan_config.network: own compose network; the app container has no resolver (dns 127.0.0.1), as for BenchmarkPython
scan_config.images: app built from the pinned source (lab/dvws.Dockerfile: node:22-bookworm-slim, npm ci, no frontend build, port 8080 as user node); mysql:5.7 and mongo:4.4, the images already in the lab (upstream compose: mysql:8, mongo:4.0.4)
scan_config.seed_data: scripts/seed-database.js at container start (upstream compose command)

collector: scripts/collect_lab.py main(['dvws-node'], 'v5', final=True): the same guarded collector as the lab apps (login, seeds, probes, stored-XSS pass, forms, passive pass); scanned once

coverage.requirement: at least 80% of the labelled reachable endpoint-params are reached, i.e. have probe records in the single scan
coverage.denominator: every dvws-node endpoint-param in ground_truth_v5.json (27; none of them is on the skip list)
coverage.numerator: labelled endpoint-params with at least one probed point in raw_v5/dvws-node.jsonl.gz
coverage.if_not_met: INCONCLUSIVE: v2 stays deployed whatever the scores

metric: ML: endpoint-param macro-F1 (dastml.evaluation.endpoint_metrics: mean F1 over the classes present in the truth), per-class P/R/F1 and counts; 95% cluster bootstrap (1000 resamples, seed 0) for each model and the paired differences. The CIs are reported but are NOT part of the rule. Rules (passive, stored XSS, CSRF, CWE-78/22/601): counts only.
units: Endpoint-param clusters exactly as dastml.evaluation.clusters builds them from the feature rows (one cluster per (app, method, path, parameter); class-split only for a parameter vulnerable to both ML classes). A cluster is predicted C if any C-payload row has P(C) >= the model's own threshold (the detector's threshold, recorded in model_thresholds); 'vulnerable parameters found' = clusters with a true class C != safe predicted as C; 'false alarms' = clusters whose true class is safe predicted as any class. Rows of classes listed as unknown are dropped (ground truth).
deployment_rule: v4 is deployed (replacing v2 on port 8002) ONLY IF (1) the coverage requirement is met AND, on the same collected records, (2) v4's endpoint-param macro-F1 is strictly higher than v2's AND (3) v4 finds at least as many vulnerable parameters as v2 AND (4) v4 has at most one more false alarm than v2. Anything else, a tie included, leaves v2 deployed and v4 packaged.
caveat: One small app (27 endpoint-params, 3 vulnerable) is weak evidence: a single cluster changes the macro-F1 by a lot, and the bootstrap intervals will be wide. A win here is a necessary condition for deployment, not proof of generalization.
no_changes_after: no tuning, rescanning or relabelling after the scan; eval_final_v5.py refuses to run twice
